name: The Americana at Brand
description: The Americana at Brand offers world-class retail, dining, and entertainment in a premier outdoor lifestyle center setting. Located in Glendale, California, just minutes from Downtown Los Angeles and Hollywood, this upscale destination features an impressive blend of luxury shopping, acclaimed restaurants, AMC Theatres, and year-round events and entertainment. It's an L.A. favorite where friends and family come to shop, dine and unwind in a beautifully designed environment.
demographics: The Americana at Brand attracts an affluent, diverse demographic with high disposable income, drawing primarily from Glendale, Burbank, and nearby Los Angeles neighborhoods. The visitor base consists of young professionals, families, and upscale shoppers aged 25-54 with above-average household incomes who seek premium shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences. The trade area encompasses one of Southern California's most prosperous communities, with shoppers exhibiting strong preferences for experiential retail, upscale dining, and leisure activities in an elegant outdoor setting.
summary: An upscale outdoor lifestyle center in Glendale offering luxury shopping, acclaimed dining, entertainment, and year-round events in an elegant, pedestrian-friendly environment.
